summary.text: David Smith has served as the state representative for District 18 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives since 2018. His House biography describes him as an Army veteran who champions rural and veterans' issues.

paragraphs.text: Smith grew up in the Divide community near Nashoba, Oklahoma, and left school at 15 to work. He later worked in the oil industry and in construction.
He completed his G.E.D. in 1995 and joined the Army in 1996, specializing in military intelligence; he received an honorable discharge after an injury during his second enlistment.
He later earned associate's and bachelor's degrees, the latter in business management, while living in Arizona, and the family then moved back to Oklahoma.

As a representative he started an annual campout for veterans and their families, a program in which students draw Christmas cards for veterans' nursing homes, and a program called Reading with the Representative.
Smith and his wife, Teresa, live in Arpelar.
